Title: Cyrena.Dotnet - IDotnetProjectType Contract
Summary: Contract for detecting and indexing .NET project types (class library, Blazor, MVC).
Content:
## IDotnetProjectType

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Dotnet.Contracts`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Dotnet`

### Purpose
Contract for detecting and indexing different .NET project types (class library, Blazor, MVC, etc.).

### Interface Definition

```csharp
public interface IDotnetProjectType
{
    string Id { get; }                    // e.g., "cs-class-library"
    string ProjectTypeName { get; }       // e.g., ".NET C# Class Library"
    
    bool IsOfType(ProjectInfo info);
    DevelopPlan IndexPlan(ProjectModel model);
}
```

### Implementations

| Implementation | Id | ProjectTypeName |
|---------------|-----|-----------------|
| `CSharpClassLibraryProjectType` | `cs-class-library` | `.NET C# Class Library` |
| `BlazorLibraryProjectType` | `cs-blazor-lib` | `Blazor Component Library` |
| `BlazorAppProjectType` | `cs-blazor-app` | `Blazor App` |
| `MvcProjectType` | `cs-mvc-app` | `MVC App` |
| `MvcLibraryProjectType` | `cs-mvc-lib` | `MVC Library` |

### IsOfType Detection
Each implementation checks `ProjectInfo` properties (SDK type, project type ID, etc.) to determine if it handles the project.

### IndexPlan Behavior
Creates a `DevelopPlan` from the project directory and indexes files according to project type conventions:
- **Class Library**: `IndexDefaultCSharpProject()` — Attributes, Contracts, Extensions, Models, Options, Services
- **Blazor**: `IndexBlazorProjectType()` — Components (root/pages/layout/shared), .cs, .json, wwwroot
- **MVC**: `IndexMvcProjectType()` — Controllers, Views (with subdirectories), .cs, .json, wwwroot

### Blazor Indexing Details
The `IndexBlazorProjectType` method indexes the following folder structure:
- `Components/` (root) → `blazor_root_` prefix for .razor, .cs, .css
- `Components/Pages/` → `blazor_pages_` prefix
- `Components/Layout/` → `blazor_layout_` prefix
- `Components/Shared/` → `blazor_shared_` prefix
- Root .cs files → `blazor_cs_` prefix
- Root .json files → `blazor_json_` prefix
- `wwwroot/` → `public_` prefix (html, css, js)

**Note:** Each subfolder under Components is created as a child of the `components` folder, and files are indexed within their respective subfolders.
